title: ADUTNFRANCEK 's old Happy ghasts
body:
Mojang changed the texture of Ghast and Happy Ghast to a newer and more pixelated one in the new Snapshot, so I created this texture pack to change the look of Happy Ghast to the look of the old Ghast we've known for years!

Thanks to kleiders3010 at Curseforge and Modringht for the Happy ghast texture!

Thanks @RustToaster for the harness texture!
